name: Kulaxyz/self-learning
description: Self-improving skill for coding agents: it harvests hard-won session knowledge (deploy commands, live verification steps, project conventions) into committed, shared skills and rules instead of losing that knowledge at /clear. The skill itself instructs stripping credentials from harvested material (for example redis, https user and password, amqp, and kafka connection strings). Warning: Auto-commits terminal sessions to git; review credentials and secrets before use.
